card.name: Start of drug names beginning with L
card.fires_on: The first letter L of a drug name, often in capitals, right after words like receiving, taking, discontinue or withhold. It fires where a brand or generic drug name begins in a label.

modes.label: Capitalized brand names
modes.description: The letter L begins an all-caps brand name after a verb or phrase about taking or stopping the drug.
modes.example: patients with compensated cirrhosis frequently and discontinue<< L>>IVMARLI if hepatic decomp

modes.label: Lowercase generic names
modes.description: A lowercase l begins a generic drug name after a prescribing or co-administration phrase.
modes.example: Anyone considering prescribing<< l>>acosamide or any other AED must

card.writes: It suppresses the word compound and its variants, so it does not add much clear output beyond finishing a drug name.
card.plain: It marks the first letter L of a drug name that comes right after words like taking or receiving.
